stillBlocks: credentials or live bank calls, data, or consent

decisionBoundary.rule: #190 implements every accepted domestic investment pattern named by #172 without silently narrowing the launch boundary. Removing one requires reopening #172 and obtaining a revised #180 handoff.

criteria.requirement: All accepted acquisition, disposal, dividend, distribution, and simple ownership patterns have deterministic commands, lots, rounding, errors, document identities, ledger postings, and versioned golden cases.
criteria.expectedResult: The canonical investments capability supports Norwegian private-company shares and low-volume NOK listed shares or funds with clear tax treatment, including purchases, sales, ordinary received dividends or distributions, and simple ownership changes. Each accepted pattern produces cent-exact deterministic positions, lots, allocations, tax facts, document/source bindings, and ledger commands from versioned golden inputs.

criteria.requirement: Ordinary NOK broker and bank evidence plus a manual fallback are supported without creating a second accounting system.
criteria.expectedResult: Every accepted investment command can bind immutable provider-neutral bank, broker, and document evidence or a typed owner-entered fallback. Required evidence gaps, stale identities, hash mismatches, and conflicting source facts block before mutation; fallback records facts but never invents tax or accounting judgment.

criteria.requirement: Foreign, derivatives, crypto, active trading, complex reorganizations or distributions, unclear tax, and judgment-dependent investment cases hard-block without partial state.
criteria.expectedResult: Typed risk responses reject FX, foreign withholding or tax credit, crypto, derivatives, active or high-volume trading, property investments, unclear fund treatment, non-cash or complex distributions, reorganizations, options, warrants, treasury shares, inheritance or gift edge cases, and any ambiguous ownership or tax fact before investment, ledger, document-link, bank-match, audit, or receipt mutation.

criteria.requirement: Positions, lots, and immutable investment facts reconcile to ledger, RF-1086, company tax, annual accounts, SAF-T, and archive outputs.
criteria.expectedResult: Each accepted golden case binds one economic-fact identity and proves exact agreement between investments positions/lots/allocations, balanced ledger entries, and the currently canonical RF-1086, tax, annual-accounts, SAF-T, and archive consumers. Missing, stale, contradictory, or merely declared output evidence cannot count as reconciliation.

criteria.requirement: Atomicity, idempotency, correction, tenant isolation, security, browser and mobile owner journeys, and old/new comparison pass for the complete supported slice.
criteria.expectedResult: Accepted commands commit exactly once with immutable correction lineage and no partial fragments on failure. Wrong-tenant and insufficient-role access fail under forced RLS. Guided desktop and mobile owner paths use FastAPI/generated contracts and comparison fixtures preserve the characterized behavior.

criteria.requirement: One Python investments implementation remains and the complete local, hosted, preview, comparison, security, architecture, and release gates pass twice on linked immutable revisions.
criteria.expectedResult: No TypeScript business policy, legacy FIFO RPC, SQL policy duplicate, new compatibility record, or alternate writer remains. Architecture and Graphify agree; local and owner-designated hosted database evidence is reconciled; an exact immutable Preview receipt exists; and two consecutive complete customer-ready gates pass before #147 is claimed.
